third_party_comparison_review.purpose: Sample its current public Space Marines pages as an additional discrepancy detector; this is not rules certification.

findings.provider_values: T4; 5/10 models cost 80/150 points; Objective Secured and Hail of Bolts.
findings.current_reference_values: T5; 5/10 models cost 85/170 points; Bolter Discipline and Tactical Mainstay.
findings.assessment: Material mismatch in characteristics, points and ability set. Do not use provider values for current roster or runtime data.

findings.provider_values: T4; chainsword S4; 5/10 models cost 75/150 points; Targeted Intercession rerolls Wound rolls against a selected target, with a stronger reroll near objectives.
findings.current_reference_values: T5; chainsword S5; 5/10 models cost 85/170 points; after a charge, melee attacks gain +1 Strength and +1 AP.
findings.assessment: Material mismatch in characteristics, weapon profile, points and ability effect. The shared ability name does not indicate shared mechanics.

findings.provider_values: T6; 5/10 models cost 100/200 points; Unyielding in the Face of the Foe grants +1 to armour saving throws against Damage 1 attacks while within range of an objective controlled by the player.
findings.current_reference_values: T6; 5/10 models cost 115/230 points; while controlling an objective, the unit has +1 to save rolls.
findings.assessment: Material mismatch in points and ability trigger/effect wording. Similar phrasing must not be treated as the same mechanic.

findings.provider_values: T5; 5/10 models cost 160/320 points; Storm Bolter S4/AP0; Fury of the First adds 1 to Hit rolls against the Oath of Moment target; Teleport Homer uses 0CP and an 8-inch enemy exclusion.
findings.current_reference_values: T6; 5/10 models cost 190/380 points; Storm Bolter S5/AP-1; Fury of the First adds 1 AP against units within 9 inches; Teleport Homer modifies Rapid Ingress cost and uses a 9-inch enemy exclusion.
findings.assessment: Material mismatch across profile, weapon, points and abilities, including an older Oath-linked rule.

third_party_comparison_review.conclusion: The sampled 40k.app Space Marines pages lag current Codex-era e11 reference content in multiple fields. Keep the app as a candidate discovery and discrepancy surface only; verify each rule/profile against the current requested e11 reference and applicable official GW source before catalog admission. Do not import or use these sampled values for gameplay.
